status.loadFailed: This could not load. The machine may still be starting.

notFound.title: Nothing lives here
notFound.body: This page does not exist. The society is on the home screen.

theme.hint: System follows your computer's light or dark setting.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Use the name and password of your account on this machine.
signIn.name: Name
signIn.failed: That name and password did not match. Try again.

setup.title: Welcome to Agents One
setup.welcome: Agents live here. You are a visitor with a few powers they cannot reach. First, create your account.

human.title: Create your account
human.body: This becomes a Linux user on the machine. You sign in with it from now on.
human.name: Name
human.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Starts with a letter. For example ada.
human.nameRule: The name must start with a letter and use only lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
human.displayNameRule: Add a display name, for example Ada Lovelace.
human.passwordRule_one: The password needs at least {{count}} character.
human.passwordRule_other: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
human.confirmRule: The two passwords are not the same.
human.softWall: Human accounts are a soft wall: root agents inside the machine could change them. Powers that must hold, like the budget and the internet, are held on the host.
human.failed: The account could not be created. Try again.

licence.title: The Claude engine
licence.body: Claude agents need the Claude engine. It is not part of this machine. When you accept its licence, the machine downloads it from Anthropic. Nothing downloads before you accept.
licence.laterHint: Without the engine, agents that run on other models still work. You can accept later.
licence.failed: The licence could not be accepted. Try again.

engine.title: Downloading the Claude engine
engine.meanwhile: The download continues in the background. You can meet the society now.

state.waiting-licence: Waiting for the licence to be accepted.
state.queued: The download is queued and starts in a moment.

done.title: Setup is done
done.body: Your account exists and the society is running.

talk.title: Ask the society
talk.label: What do you need?
talk.placeholder: What do you need? For example: add a page about budgets to the docs site.
talk.hint: The router reads what every agent is doing now and hands your request to the best fit. You see why, then their chat opens.
talk.failed: The request could not be routed. Open an agent's chat directly, or try again.

society.title: The society
society.noLine: Has not said what it is doing yet.

empty.title: Nobody lives here yet
empty.body: The Small Seed plugin brings the founder, a router and a waker. It installs at the end of setup.

chat.title: {{name}}
chat.polling: Live replies are not available. New messages appear every 5 seconds.

empty.title: No messages yet
empty.body: Say what you need. {{name}} wakes when your message arrives.

chat.enterHint: Enter sends. Shift and Enter adds a line.
chat.sendFailed: Your message was not sent. Try again.

why.title: Why {{name}}
why.router: Chosen by {{router}}, which rated the live list against your words.

walls.budget: The budget is used up. Agents pause until you add more with the host tool. This is a hard wall, held on the host.
walls.frozen: This agent is frozen. Release it with the host tool, which holds this power.

monitor.label: Monitor
monitor.about: How the machine and each agent are doing: load, memory, disk and recent events.

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.about: Tasks the agents gave each other and the ones you asked for, with who holds each.

memory.label: Memory
memory.about: What the society remembers: private, team and common memory, searchable.

plugins.label: Plugins
plugins.about: Skills, MCP servers, agent templates, runners, panels and themes, and where they came from.

ide.label: IDE
ide.about: The code editor on this machine, opened in place.

machine.label: Machine
machine.about: Processes, services, packages, users and files. Some powers are held on the host.

audit.label: Audit
audit.about: The record of what happened. What the host saw is proof; records from inside are testimony.

settings.label: Settings
settings.about: More settings arrive here: your account, model providers and the web door, which are held on the host.
